user.title: Connect to TinyPilot
user.description: Enter the TinyPilot device's hostname or IP and the REST API Bearer token from /etc/tinypilot/custom-api.conf on the device.

confirm.title: Confirm this device
confirm.description:
Connected to **{hostname}** (TinyPilot {tinypilot_version}) at {host}.

TLS certificate SHA-256 fingerprint:
`{fingerprint}`

This fingerprint will be pinned -- Home Assistant will only trust exactly this certificate for this device from now on. Confirm it matches what you expect before continuing.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to TinyPilot
reauth_confirm.description: Re-enter the host and API key for this device. This also re-pins its TLS certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device. Check the host and that the API service is running.
